steps.hardClue: Activate the teleporter and escape the rapidly advancing rounds.
steps.clue: Activate the Staging Area teleporter and escape the rapidly advancing rounds.

steps.hardClue: Collect four parts and repair the broken teleporter.
steps.clue: Collect four parts in Anytown and repair the Fuel Processing teleporter.

steps.hardClue: Defeat the three-headed enemy, then lift the facility lockdown.
steps.clue: Defeat the Abomination, enter the Observation Tower and unlock Pack-a-Punch.

steps.hardClue: Press the hidden red button beside the covered windows.
steps.clue: Press the hidden red button in the Observation Tower to reveal the Forsaken.

steps.hardClue: Destroy the orbiting orbs around three large crystals with the Wonder Weapon.
steps.clue: Use the Chrysalax to destroy orbs around three Aetherium Crystals, then collect their Crystal Shards.

steps.hardClue: Feed the shards to three large enemies, then kill them to recover altered shards.
steps.clue: Feed the Crystal Shards to Abominations, then kill them to collect Catalyzed Crystal Shards.

steps.hardClue: Build the protective device using three parts and three altered crystal shards.
steps.clue: Build the Aetherium Neutralizer with its three parts and three Catalyzed Crystal Shards.

steps.hardClue: Escort the device, refueling it with orange crystal shards.
steps.clue: Escort the Aetherium Neutralizer down Main Street, refueling it with orange crystal shards.

steps.hardClue: Break the boss’s armor, charge two cannons and fire them at the exposed weak points.
steps.clue: Break the Forsaken’s armor, charge Maxis’s laser cannons and fire them at his exposed weak points.
